+"""Gate 2: lint, types, dependencies and the deterministic authority boundary.
+
+Runs ``ruff check .`` over the repository, a meaningful mypy check over the new
+``src/research_desk`` package (``--follow-imports=skip`` so the untouched
+upstream package is not silently made part of the new type contract), and
+``python -m pip check`` for dependency consistency. It then scans the policy /
+review / storage / graph-adapter modules for the structural authority boundary:
+``review`` and ``policy`` must never import an LLM, and the graph must never
+import a function that grants approval or mutates the ledger.
+
+Genuine application lint/type findings are reported with file:line and the gate
+fails; this implementation does not own application source, so findings are
+surfaced to the supervisor rather than suppressed.
+
+In PR mode, a change on a safety-relevant path must carry a corresponding ADR
+or approval evidence that references the changed file.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import ast
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _gate_lib import add_change_args, changed_files, fail, resolve_root, run, tool_path
+
+# Modules that own deterministic authority and therefore must not touch an LLM.
+NO_LLM_MODULES = ("policy", "review")
+# Functions that grant approval or mutate the ledger; the graph must not import them.
+LEDGER_AUTHORITY_NAMES = {
+    "approve",
+    "execute",
+    "apply_transaction",
+    "ResearchDeskStore",
+    "save_proposal",
+}
+# Safety-relevant paths (permission-model.md) whose change needs a covering ADR/approval.
+SAFETY_PATHS = (
+    "src/research_desk/policy.py",
+    "src/research_desk/review.py",
+    "src/research_desk/storage.py",
+    "src/research_desk/config.py",
+    "src/research_desk/graph_adapter.py",
+    "src/research_desk/budget.py",
+    "src/research_desk/evidence.py",
+    ".agent/rules.md",
+    ".opencode/rules.md",
+)
+COVERING_DOC_DIRS = ("docs/architecture/adr/", "docs/process/")
+
+
+def _top_level_imports(tree: ast.Module) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Return (top-level module names, imported member names)."""
+    modules: list[str] = []
+    members: list[str] = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            modules.extend(alias.name for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            if node.module:
+                modules.append(node.module)
+            members.extend(alias.asname or alias.name for alias in node.names)
+    return modules, members
+
+
+def check_authority_boundary(root: Path, failures: list[str]) -> None:
+    for mod in NO_LLM_MODULES:
+        path = root / "src/research_desk" / f"{mod}.py"
+        if not path.exists():
+            failures.append(f"authority module missing: {path}")
+            continue
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        modules, members = _top_level_imports(tree)
+        llm_imports = [m for m in modules if m == "langchain" or m.startswith("langchain_")]
+        if llm_imports:
+            failures.append(
+                f"{mod}.py must not import an LLM module; found: {llm_imports}"
+            )
+        if "create_llm_client" in members:
+            failures.append(f"{mod}.py must not import create_llm_client")
+        if any(n.startswith("langchain") for n in modules):
+            failures.append(f"{mod}.py has a langchain-family import")
+
+    graph_path = root / "src/research_desk/graph_adapter.py"
+    if graph_path.exists():
+        tree = ast.parse(graph_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        modules, members = _top_level_imports(tree)
+        forbidden = sorted(LEDGER_AUTHORITY_NAMES & set(members))
+        if forbidden:
+            failures.append(
+                f"graph_adapter.py must not import approval/ledger-mutation "
+                f"functions; found: {forbidden}"
+            )
+        if any(m == "research_desk.storage" or m.endswith(".storage") for m in modules):
+            failures.append("graph_adapter.py must not import research_desk.storage")
+
+
+def check_safety_path_evidence(
+    root: Path, changed: list[str], failures: list[str]
+) -> None:
+    safety_changed = [c for c in changed if c in SAFETY_PATHS]
+    if not safety_changed:
+        return
+    docs_text = ""
+    for base in COVERING_DOC_DIRS:
+        base_dir = root / base
+        if base_dir.is_dir():
+            for p in base_dir.rglob("*.md"):
+                docs_text += p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") + "\n"
+    for path in safety_changed:
+        name = Path(path).name
+        module = Path(path).stem
+        if name not in docs_text and module not in docs_text:
+            failures.append(
+                f"safety-path change {path} lacks a covering ADR/approval evidence "
+                "that references it"
+            )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gate 2: static/type/dependency + boundary.")
+    add_change_args(parser)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    root: Path = resolve_root(args.root)
+    checks: list[str] = []
+    failures: list[str] = []
+
+    ruff = tool_path(root, "ruff")
+    proc = run([ruff, "check", "."], root)
+    checks.append(f"ruff check . -> exit {proc.returncode}")
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        findings = [
+            line for line in (proc.stdout or "").splitlines()
+            if ": error:" in line or ": warning:" in line
+        ]
+        if not findings:
+            findings = (proc.stdout or "").splitlines()[:40]
+        failures.append("ruff reported lint findings:")
+        failures.extend(f"  {f}" for f in findings)
+
+    mypy = tool_path(root, "mypy")
+    mproc = run(
+        [mypy, "src/research_desk", "--follow-imports=skip", "--ignore-missing-imports"],
+        root,
+    )
+    checks.append(f"mypy src/research_desk -> exit {mproc.returncode}")
+    if mproc.returncode != 0:
+        findings = [
+            line for line in (mproc.stdout or "").splitlines()
+            if ": error:" in line
+        ]
+        if not findings:
+            findings = (mproc.stdout or "").splitlines()[:40]
+        failures.append("mypy reported type findings (src/research_desk):")
+        failures.extend(f"  {f}" for f in findings)
+
+    py = tool_path(root, "python") or "python"
+    pproc = run([py, "-m", "pip", "check"], root)
+    checks.append(f"pip check -> exit {pproc.returncode}")
+    if pproc.returncode != 0:
+        failures.append("pip check reported broken requirements:")
+        failures.extend(f"  {l}" for l in (pproc.stdout or "").splitlines())
+
+    check_authority_boundary(root, failures)
+
+    changed = changed_files(root, args.base_ref, args.head_ref, args.changed_files)
+    if changed:
+        check_safety_path_evidence(root, changed, failures)
+
+    fail(checks, failures)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Per-agent prompt compaction applied to the *real* per-agent LLM inputs.
+
+Fresh evaluation runs have essentially no past memory, so compressing only
+``past_context`` has almost no effect. This module applies compaction to the
+actual message inputs each agent sends and to the output-length instruction,
+by wrapping the real LangChain chat model with a small application-owned
+delegate that exposes the methods the graph actually uses — ``invoke``,
+``bind_tools`` and ``with_structured_output`` — while retaining the real
+LangChain client and upstream ``GraphSetup``.
+
+For ``context_mode == "baseline"`` the delegate is a no-op: the exact, real
+uncompressed client is returned unchanged (no artificial padding, no rewrite).
+For ``compact`` the delegate trims redundant message text, de-duplicates, and
+appends a concise-output instruction, while preserving key quoted facts (the
+standing-constraints markers) in every affected prompt.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, BaseMessage, HumanMessage, SystemMessage
+
+# Content markers that carry the facts which must survive compaction. A message
+# containing any marker is kept (not trimmed below the fact floor).
+_FACT_MARKERS = (
+    "STANDING ANALYSIS CONSTRAINTS",
+    "last_close",
+    "NO_DATA_AVAILABLE",
+    "source_id",
+    "src-",
+    "USD",
+    "% of equity",
+    "integer_shares",
+    "no_shorting",
+    "Analysis date",
+    "Company:",
+    "Instrument identity",
+    "trade_date",
+    "past_context",
+)
+
+_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION = (
+    "Respond concisely: keep your entire answer within {max_tokens} tokens. "
+    "Do not repeat the input; only output the requested analysis."
+)
+
+
+def _to_messages(input: Any) -> list[BaseMessage] | None:
+    """Normalise a model input to a list of messages, or None if not list-like."""
+    if isinstance(input, list) and all(isinstance(m, BaseMessage) for m in input):
+        return list(input)
+    if isinstance(input, str):
+        return [HumanMessage(content=input)]
+    if hasattr(input, "to_messages"):
+        try:
+            return input.to_messages()
+        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - PromptValue edge cases
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _content_of(msg: BaseMessage) -> str:
+    c = msg.content
+    return c if isinstance(c, str) else str(c)
+
+
+def _has_fact_marker(text: str) -> bool:
+    low = text.lower()
+    return any(marker.lower() in low for marker in _FACT_MARKERS)
+
+
+def compact_transform(
+    input: Any,
+    *,
+    max_output_tokens: int = 1800,
+    max_msg_chars: int = 1500,
+    fact_floor_chars: int = 6000,
+) -> Any:
+    """Transform a per-agent prompt for the compact arm.
+
+    Keeps message roles, trims verbose non-fact prose to ``max_msg_chars``,
+    removes exact duplicate messages, and appends a concise-output instruction.
+    Messages carrying key facts are preserved up to ``fact_floor_chars`` so no
+    grounding marker is dropped.
+    """
+    messages = _to_messages(input)
+    if messages is None:
+        return input  # cannot transform; pass through unchanged
+
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    kept: list[BaseMessage] = []
+    for msg in messages:
+        content = _content_of(msg)
+        if not content:
+            continue
+        if content in seen:
+            continue  # drop exact duplicate messages
+        seen.add(content)
+        if not _has_fact_marker(content) and len(content) > max_msg_chars:
+            content = content[:max_msg_chars].rstrip() + "\n[... compacted ...]"
+        kept.append(_rebuild(msg, content))
+
+    kept.append(
+        SystemMessage(content=_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION.format(max_tokens=max_output_tokens))
+    )
+    return kept
+
+
+def _rebuild(msg: BaseMessage, content: str) -> BaseMessage:
+    """Rebuild a message of the same role with trimmed content (preserve id/name)."""
+    if isinstance(msg, AIMessage):
+        return AIMessage(content=content, id=getattr(msg, "id", None), name=getattr(msg, "name", None))
+    if isinstance(msg, HumanMessage):
+        return HumanMessage(content=content, id=getattr(msg, "id", None), name=getattr(msg, "name", None))
+    return SystemMessage(content=content, id=getattr(msg, "id", None), name=getattr(msg, "name", None))
+
+
+def wrap_for_mode(
+    llm: Any,
+    context_mode: str,
+    *,
+    max_output_tokens: int = 1800,
+    max_msg_chars: int = 1500,
+) -> Any:
+    """Return a compact delegate for ``llm``, or the identical client for baseline.
+
+    Baseline returns the *same* object (no wrapping, no rewrite). Compact
+    returns a lightweight subclass of the real model type that overrides
+    ``invoke`` to transform the per-agent input; ``bind_tools`` and
+    ``with_structured_output`` are inherited from the real class and route their
+    calls back through this overridden ``invoke``.
+    """
+    if context_mode != "compact":
+        return llm
+    delegate = llm.model_copy(deep=False)
+    delegate.__class__ = _make_delegate(type(llm), max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens, max_msg_chars=max_msg_chars)
+    return delegate
+
+
+def wrap_llm_client_factory(
+    orig_factory,
+    context_mode: str,
+    *,
+    max_output_tokens: int = 1800,
+    max_msg_chars: int = 1500,
+):
+    """Wrap the upstream ``create_llm_client`` so ``get_llm()`` returns a delegate.
+
+    Used by the runner to scope compaction to the LLMs a single graph builds,
+    without touching vendor or graph code. Baseline passes the client through
+    unchanged.
+    """
+
+    def factory(provider: str, model: str, base_url: str | None = None, **kwargs):
+        client = orig_factory(provider, model, base_url, **kwargs)
+        if context_mode != "compact":
+            return client
+
+        class _WrappedClient:
+            def __init__(self, inner):
+                self._inner = inner
+
+            def get_llm(self):
+                return wrap_for_mode(
+                    self._inner.get_llm(),
+                    context_mode,
+                    max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
+                    max_msg_chars=max_msg_chars,
+                )
+
+            def get_provider_name(self):
+                return self._inner.get_provider_name()
+
+            def warn_if_unknown_model(self):
+                return self._inner.warn_if_unknown_model()
+
+            def validate_model(self):
+                return self._inner.validate_model()
+
+        return _WrappedClient(client)
+
+    return factory
+
+
+def _make_delegate(cls, *, max_output_tokens: int, max_msg_chars: int) -> type:
+    class _CompactionDelegate(cls):  # type: ignore[valid-type, misc]
+        def invoke(self, input, config=None, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN001
+            transformed = compact_transform(
+                input, max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens, max_msg_chars=max_msg_chars
+            )
+            return super().invoke(transformed, config, **kwargs)
+
+    _CompactionDelegate.__name__ = f"{cls.__name__}CompactionDelegate"
+    return _CompactionDelegate

 Live runs use the actual upstream graph — its real analysts, bull/bear

 with two narrow extension points owned by the subclass:
 
 - ``resolve_instrument_context`` is overridden to *record* the direct
   ticker-identity data path (callbacks cannot see it) and to substitute a
   frozen identity on controlled reruns.
 - ``_fetch_returns`` is overridden to record the direct realized-returns read
   and to skip network resolution on frozen reruns.
 - ``_create_tool_nodes`` is overridden so a controlled rerun feeds the exact
   frozen evidence back into the same ToolNodes the live graph uses. The graph
   topology and every agent are untouched.
 
 There is no monkeypatching of global state, no replacement of upstream agents
 and no toy pipeline: the frozen-tool variant is the same compiled graph with
 the same nodes, only its data source is frozen.
 
 ``ResearchRunner`` orchestrates one run: assemble context (baseline/compact),
 stream the graph with the evidence recorder + budget, capture the final state,
 derive the signal deterministically, write reports, and create a PENDING_REVIEW
 proposal when the signal is tradeable.

 def price_from_evidence(snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]], ticker: str) -> float | None:
     """Extract the latest close for ``ticker`` from frozen get_stock_data evidence.
 
     This is the only price source for proposals — the operator never types a
     price. Returns ``None`` when no price evidence exists (the proposal then
     cannot be approved until evidence is supplied).
     """
     import csv
     import io
 
     table = snapshot.get("get_stock_data", {})
     best: float | None = None
     for result in table.values():
         if not result.startswith("# Stock data for"):
             continue
         # Skip the leading '#' comment lines so DictReader sees the real header.
         csv_lines = [ln for ln in result.splitlines() if ln and not ln.startswith("#")]
         if not csv_lines:
             continue
         try:
             rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO("\n".join(csv_lines))))
         except Exception:
             continue
         for row in reversed(rows):
             close = row.get("Close")
             if close:
                 try:
                     best = float(close)
                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
                     continue
                 break
     return best

     snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]],

     """Decide whether a run yields a PENDING_REVIEW proposal.
 
     The single place that enforces "a budget-stopped or failed run is never
     approvable, and Hold/REVIEW do not trade". Tradeable signals are the Buy
     family (buy) and Sell family (sell, validated against owned shares at
     execution); the price must come from evidence.

     if outcome != RunOutcome.COMPLETED.value:
         return None  # budget-stopped / failed runs never become approvable (NFR-003)

     if signal not in BUY_SIGNALS and signal not in SELL_SIGNALS:
         return None
     price = price_from_evidence(snapshot, ticker)
     if price is None:
         return None  # price must come from evidence; no price -> nothing to review
     try:

             ticker=ticker,
             trade_date=trade_date,
             signal=signal,
             rating=signal,
             price=price,
             evidence_id=evidence_id,
         )
     except ReviewError:
         return None

# TradingAgents Research Desk 项目方案\n2: \n3: 状态：供主线程自主采纳的实施方案；应用实现尚未开始。用户已授权教学评估实验中的模拟学生决策，所有此类记录标为leo。指标为验收目标，没有已完成实验结果。\n4: \n5: ## 一、交付范围\n6: \n7: 在现有 TradingAgents 上交付完整流程：**运行研究 → 保存证据包 → 对照研究配置 → 审阅建议 → 确定性策略校验 → 更新模拟账本**。\n8: \n9: 第一版使用 CLI 和 HTML/Markdown 报告。只支持 market/news 分析员、US 股票和英语研究报告，仍沿用上游 bull/bear、research manager、trader、risk 与 portfolio manager 流程。完成可演示的纵向切片后再考虑界面美化，不接真实交易。\n10: \n11: 这三功能是可实现的起始范围。课程按 N 名组员提出新增需求，当前实际人数未知；后续按真实人数分配有意义的切片，不能把机械拆分当作个人贡献。\n12: \n13: ## 二、基线与只读核对结果\n14: \n15: 建议固定官方 [TradingAgents v0.4.0](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/tree/v0.4.0)，不用滚动 main。已通过 `git ls-remote --tags` 确认标签存在，并下载只读源码到 `/private/tmp/cs5351-tradingagents-v0.4.0`。包版本为0.4.0，要求Python>=3.10。\n16: \n17: v0.4.0于2026-08-31发布，包含日期一致性与恢复修复。它是正式标签，但刚发布，不能声称已长期稳定验证；开始实施时跑一次已有离线测试建立本地基线。[官方变更记录](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md)\n18: \n19: 已核对的实际接口：\n20: \n21: - `TradingAgentsGraph(selected_analysts, debug, config, callbacks)`。\n22: - `propagate(company_name, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\")` 返回 `(final_state, signal)`，signal可能为REVIEW。\n23: - `save_reports(final_state, ticker, save_path=None)` 输出报告。\n24: - 上游已有结构化输出、decision memory、checkpoint、日期过滤、价格验证、token统计。上述能力都属于继承功能，不能算作本组创新。\n25: - 实际图止于Portfolio Manager，随后保存状态和决策。对源码的查询未找到独立人工批准状态机或模拟账本；README的模拟执行概述不能代替实现证据。\n26: \n27: 保留上游 `tradingagents/`、`cli/` 和 `tests/`。新增模块放 `src/research_desk/`，新增课程测试放 `test/offline/`、`test/live/`，CI同时跑原测试。不要为符合目录树而重写上游代码。\n28: \n29: ## 三、新增需求\n30: \n31: ### F1：研究证据包与离线复现\n32: \n33: 保存分析日期、股票、模型/配置、prompt版本、实际输入资料、LLM请求/结果/usage、报告、决策及本次用到的记忆。导出资料包并生成来源索引。\n34: \n35: 离线复现读取已捕获状态与事件，重建报告和模拟策略结果，完全不调用网络。受控重跑则用冻结资料再次调用LLM，供比较配置；LLM的输出仍可能变化，两种功能需要明确区分。\n36: \n37: | ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n38: |---|---|---|\n39: | FR-001 | Must | 一条命令导出完整证据包，新进程可导入并重建报告；列出所有实际调用和运行配置 |\n40: | NFR-001 | Must | 固定6包离线复现成功率100%，外部调用数0，结构化决策/策略结果相同；本机单包重建<2秒 |\n41: | SEC-001 | Must | 输出不包含API凭证；所有未来才可用的资料不得用于声明为历史评估的研究 |\n42: \n43: 报告生成时间等展示元数据不参与一致性判断。文件摘要仅用于完整性，不充当用户版本号。上游已有价格snapshot；增量是跨输入、运行和结果的可移交证据包。\n44: \n45: ### F2：人工批准的模拟账本\n46: \n47: 研究结束产生待审阅建议。操作员选择股数并批准，系统根据当前账本、冻结价格与策略判断是否允许模拟执行。状态为 `PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED/REJECTED → SIMULATED/REVIEW_REQUIRED`。Hold或REVIEW不产生交易。\n48: \n49: 初版教学策略：现金USD100000、仅整股、禁止卖空、买入后单股票市值<=组合权益10%。批准绑定具体建议版本，执行前重查当前账本；重复执行同一批准不会重复记账。模型只建议方向和解释，不能设定政策、批准者或余额。\n50: \n51: | ID Enforcement happens in the evidence recorder's\n``on_chat_model_start``: once the configured call limit is reached, the next\ncall raises :class:`BudgetExhausted` so the graph aborts and no further LLM\nrequest is started (NFR-003). A budget-stopped run returns incomplete research\nand is never turned into an approvable recommendation.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport threading\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n\nfrom .models import CallUsage, UsageSummary\n\n\nclass BudgetExhausted(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the configured LLM call budget is exhausted.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, limit: int):\n        self.limit = limit\n        super().__init__(f\"LLM call budget exhausted (limit={limit}); refusing to start next call\")\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass BudgetTracker:\n    \"\"\"Thread-safe per-run call budget + usage accumulator.\"\"\"\n\n    max_calls: int | None = None\n    _lock: threading.Lock = field(default_factory=threading.Lock, repr=False)\n    calls_started: int = 0\n    usage: UsageSummary = field(default_factory=UsageSummary)\n\n    def can_start(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Whether a new LLM call is permitted under the budget.\"\"\"\n        if self.max_calls is None:\n            return True\n        return self.calls_started < self.max_calls\n\n    def start_call(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Register the start of an LLM call; raise when budget exhausted.\"\"\"\n        with self._lock:\n            if not self.can_start():\n                raise BudgetExhausted(self.max_calls)\n            self.calls_started += 1\n\n    def record_usage(self, usage: CallUsage) -> None:\n        with self._lock:\n            self.usage.add(usage)\n\n    def stop_reason(self) -> str:\n        if self.max_calls is not None and self.calls_started >= self.max_calls:\n            return \"budget_exhausted\"\n        return \"completed\"\n\n    def summary(self) -> UsageSummary:\n        with self._lock:\n            return UsageSummary(\n                calls=self.calls_started,\n                input_tokens=self.usage.input_tokens,\n                output_tokens=self.usage.output_tokens,\n                total_tokens=self.usage.total_tokens,\n                stop_reason=self.stop_reason(),\n            )\n\n    def merge(self, other: \"BudgetTracker\") -> None:\n        \"\"\"Merge another tracker's counts (used to aggregate baseline/compact arms).\"\"\"\n        with self._lock:\n            self.calls_started += other.calls_started\n            self.usage.calls += other.usage.calls\n            self.usage.input_tokens += other.usage.input_tokens\n            self.usage.output_tokens += other.usage.output_tokens\n            self.usage.total_tokens += other.usage.total_tokens\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/Users/leeyoma/Downloads/cs5351/work/project/src/research_desk/budget.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"src/research_desk/budget.py","time":{"start":1788178376318,"end":1788178376320}},"id":"prt_057bc95cf001zreRZbUg63V8zP","sessionID":"ses_fa849396effeNN2dsVIpTIaax8","messageID":"msg_057bc8e9f001YZHT7gSGxaHNaY"}}

```python
"""Shared helpers for the Research Desk CI gate scripts."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def project_root() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

def tool_path(root: Path, name: str) -> str:
    local = root / ".venv" / "bin" / name
    if local.exists():
        return str(local)
    import shutil
    found = shutil.which(name)
    if found:
        return found
    return str(local)

def run(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True)

def changed_files(root: Path, base_ref: str | None = None, head_ref: str | None = None, explicit: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
    if explicit:
        return [f for f in explicit.split(",") if f.strip()]
    if base_ref:
        cmd = ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--name-only", base_ref]
        if head_ref:
            cmd.append(head_ref)
        p = run(cmd, root)
        if p.returncode != 0:
            print(f"git diff failed: {p.stderr.strip()}", file=sys.stderr)
            return []
        return [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    # No change source provided: use working-tree changes (modified + untracked).
    p = run(["git", "-C", str(root), "status", "--porcelain=v1"], root)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return []
    out = []
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
        if len(line) > 3:
            out.append(line[3:].strip())
    return out

def add_change_args(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=None, help="Repository root (defaults to project root).")
    parser.add_argument("--base-ref", default=None, help="Base ref for PR change detection.")
    parser.add_argument("--head-ref", default=None, help="Head ref for PR change detection.")
    parser.add_argument("--changed-files", default=None, help="Comma-separated explicit changed file list (negative-test override).")
```

import argparse

from pathlib import Path


def project_root() -> Path:
    """Repo root: this file lives in ``<root>/scripts/``."""
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def resolve_root(root: str | None) -> Path:
    return Path(root).resolve() if root else project_root()


def tool_path(root: Path, name: str) -> str:
    """Prefer the isolated project venv, then the PATH executable."""
    local = root / ".venv" / "bin" / name
    if local.exists():
        return str(local)
    found = shutil.which(name)
    if found:

    return str(local)


def run(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    """Run a command, capturing output. Exit status is not masked here."""
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True)


def _parse_status_line(line: str) -> str | None:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        return None
    # porcelain v1: "XY path" (renames/copies include a second path segment).
    if len(line) > 3:
        return line[3:].split(" -> ")[0].strip()
    return None


def changed_files(
    root: Path,
    base_ref: str | None = None,
    head_ref: str | None = None,
    explicit: str | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Resolve the set of changed file paths for a change gate.

    Priority: an explicit ``--changed-files`` list (enables reproducible
    negative examples without editing the repo), else a git base..head diff,
    else the working-tree changes (modified + untracked) so initial/local work
    is handled honestly rather than pretending nothing changed.
    """
    if explicit:
        return [f.strip() for f in explicit.split(",") if f.strip()]
    if base_ref:
        cmd = ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--name-only", base_ref]
        if head_ref:
            cmd.append(head_ref)
        proc = run(cmd, root)
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            print(f"ERROR: git diff failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}", file=sys.stderr)
            return []
        return [l for l in proc.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    proc = run(["git", "-C", str(root), "status", "--porcelain=v1"], root)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return []
    files = []
    for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
        path = _parse_status_line(line)
        if path:
            files.append(path)
    return files


def add_change_args(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=None, help="Repository root (defaults to project root).")
    parser.add_argument("--base-ref", default=None, help="Base ref for PR change detection.")
    parser.add_argument("--head-ref", default=None, help="Head ref for PR change detection.")
    parser.add_argument(

    if failures:
        print("FAILURES:")

    if not data.get("test_plan_version"):

            checks.append("note: approval must predate any spec/test change (see timestamps above)")

    fail(checks, failures)

def _top_level_imports(tree: ast.Module) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Return (top-level module names, imported member names)."""
    modules: list[str] = []
    members: list[str] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            modules.extend(alias.name for alias in node.names)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            if node.module:
                modules.append(node.module)
            members.extend(alias.asname or alias.name for alias in node.names)
    return modules, members


def check_authority_boundary(root: Path, failures: list[str]) -> None:

        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        modules, members = _top_level_imports(tree)
        llm_imports = [m for m in modules if m == "langchain" or m.startswith("langchain_")]
        if llm_imports:

        if "create_llm_client" in members:

            failures.append(f"{mod}.py has a langchain-family import")

    if graph_path.exists():

from pathlib import Path

import yaml

KNOWN_OPERATORS = {"==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="}
FIT_OPERATORS = KNOWN_OPERATORS
COMPONENT_OPTIONAL = {".github/CODEOWNERS"}  # declared; external protection pending (GOV-004)

def _at_test_path(root: Path, at_id: str) -> Path | None:
    m = AT_RE.match(at_id)
    if not m:
        return None
    n = int(m.group(1))
    if 1 <= n <= 6:
        files = sorted((root / "test/offline").glob(f"test_at{n:02d}_*.py"))
        return files[0] if files else None
    if n == 8:
        files = sorted((root / "scripts").glob("check_*.py"))
        return files[0] if files else None
    return None  # AT-07 semantic evaluation module (added by the source owner)


def _resolve_component(root: Path, comp: str) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    if comp.startswith("research_desk."):
        p = root / "src" / (comp.replace(".", "/") + ".py")
        return p, p.exists()
    if comp.startswith("tradingagents."):
        p = root / comp.replace(".", "/")
        return p, (p.with_suffix(".py").exists() or p.is_dir())
    if comp == "scripts":
        p = root / "scripts"
        return p, p.is_dir()
    if comp.startswith(".github/"):
        p = root / comp
        return p, p.exists()
    p = root / comp
    return p, p.exists()


def _is_url(value: str) -> bool:
    return value.startswith("http://") or value.startswith("https://")


def _matrix_ids(matrix_text: str) -> set[str]:
    ids: set[str] = set()
    for line in matrix_text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith("|"):
            continue
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip("|").split("|")]
        if not cells:
            continue
        first = cells[0]
        if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z]+-\d{3}", first):
            ids.add(first)
    return ids


def _matrix_contains(matrix_text: str, token: str) -> bool:
    return token in matrix_text

            if not metric:

            if operator not in FIT_OPERATORS:

            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                failures.append(f"{rid}: fit.threshold {threshold!r} is not numeric")
            if not verification:
                failures.append(f"{rid}: fit.verification is empty")

        for source in req.get("source") or []:
            if isinstance(source, str) and not _is_url(source) and source:
                sp = root / source
                if not sp.exists():
                    failures.append(f"{rid}: source link broken -> {source}")
        for source in req.get("source") or []:
            if isinstance(source, str) and _is_url(source):
                checks.append(f"{rid}: external source accepted -> {source[:80]}...")

                continue
            _, ok = _resolve_component(root, comp)
            if not ok:

        for tid in req.get("tests") or []:
            if tid == "upstream-regression":
                if not (root / "tests").is_dir():
                    failures.append(f"{rid}: upstream-regression target tests/ missing")
                continue
            if not AT_RE.match(str(tid)):
                failures.append(f"{rid}: malformed test id {tid!r}")
                continue
            path = _at_test_path(root, tid)
            if path is None:
                checks.append(f"{rid}: test {tid} -> semantic evaluation (AT-07, integration pending)")
            elif not path.exists():
                failures.append(f"{rid}: test link broken -> {tid} ({path})")

    matrix_path = None
    for cand in TRACE_MATRIX_CANDIDATES:
        if (root / cand).exists():
            matrix_path = root / cand
            break
    if matrix_path is None:
        failures.append(
            "trace matrix not found (expected docs/architecture/trace-matrix.md); "
            "cannot verify full requirement->test traceability"
        )
    else:
        matrix_text = matrix_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        matrix_ids = _matrix_ids(matrix_text)
        checks.append(f"trace matrix IDs: {len(matrix_ids)}")
        missing_from_matrix = sorted(set(ids) - matrix_ids)
        if missing_from_matrix:
            failures.append(f"requirement IDs absent from trace matrix: {missing_from_matrix}")
        extra_in_matrix = sorted(matrix_ids - set(ids))
        if extra_in_matrix:
            failures.append(f"trace matrix lists unknown requirement IDs: {extra_in_matrix}")

            if not isinstance(req, dict):

            rid = req.get("id")
            for tid in req.get("tests") or []:
                if not _matrix_contains(matrix_text, str(tid)):
                    failures.append(f"{rid}: test {tid} not reflected in the trace matrix")

    checks.append(f"requirement count: {len(reqs)}")
    fail(checks, failures)

_NETWORK_BLOCKED_REPLAY = """
import json, socket, sys
def _block(*a, **k):
    raise OSError("network blocked during offline replay")
socket.socket.connect = _block
socket.socket.sendall = _block
socket.socket.recv = _block

from research_desk.models import LedgerState

def _blocked_replay_probe(root: Path, pack_dir: Path, out_dir: Path) -> dict:
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = os.pathsep.join([str(root), str(root / "src"), env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")])
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", _NETWORK_BLOCKED_REPLAY, str(pack_dir), str(out_dir)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
        cwd=str(root),
        env=env,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"blocked replay failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gate 4: fixed semantic regression (offline).")
    add_change_args(parser)
    parser.add_argument("--packs-dir", default="test/fixtures/packs")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root: Path = resolve_root(args.root)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))

    checks: list[str] = []
    failures: list[str] = []

    packs_dir = root / args.packs_dir
    pack_dirs = sorted(p for p in packs_dir.iterdir() if (p / "manifest.json").exists())
    checks.append(f"FIXED_CORPUS_PACKS={len(pack_dirs)}")
    for p in pack_dirs:
        checks.append(f"  pack: {p.name}")

    from research_desk.evidence import EvidencePackIO
    from research_desk.models import LedgerState
    from research_desk.policy import policy_bounds
    from research_desk.replay import ReplayEngine

    io = EvidencePackIO()
    engine = ReplayEngine()

    for pack_dir in pack_dirs:
        name = pack_dir.name
        expected = EXPECTED.get(name)
        if expected is None:
            failures.append(f"pack {name} has no fixed expected outcome in the gate")
            continue
        try:
            pack = io.import_pack(str(pack_dir))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface as a failure
            failures.append(f"pack {name} failed to import: {exc}")
            continue

        # Preserved facts / source identity.
        if expected.get("ticker") and pack.manifest.ticker != expected["ticker"]:
            failures.append(f"{name}: ticker {pack.manifest.ticker!r} != {expected['ticker']!r}")
        if pack.manifest.signal != expected["signal"]:
            failures.append(
                f"{name}: manifest signal {pack.manifest.signal!r} != expected {expected['signal']!r}"
            )
        if not pack.manifest.trade_date:
            failures.append(f"{name}: missing trade_date in manifest")
        if not pack.manifest.prompt_version:
            failures.append(f"{name}: missing prompt_version in manifest")

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            out_dir = Path(tmp)
            try:
                result = engine.replay(pack, out_dir, ledger=LedgerState(cash=100000.0))
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                failures.append(f"{name}: replay raised {exc}")
                continue
            if result.external_calls != 0:
                failures.append(f"{name}: replay performed {result.external_calls} external calls")
            if result.signal != expected["signal"]:
                failures.append(
                    f"{name}: replayed signal {result.signal!r} != expected {expected['signal']!r}"
                )
            if result.signal != pack.manifest.signal:
                failures.append(
                    f"{name}: replayed signal {result.signal!r} != manifest {pack.manifest.signal!r}"
                )

        # Policy / budget semantics.
        prop = pack.proposal
        if expected["proposal"]:
            if prop is None:
                failures.append(f"{name}: expected a PENDING_REVIEW proposal, got none")
            else:
                if prop.price is not None and abs(prop.price - expected["price"]) > 1e-9:
                    failures.append(f"{name}: proposal price {prop.price} != {expected['price']}")
                bounds = policy_bounds(LedgerState(cash=100000.0), prop.price)
                if bounds.get("max_by_cap") != expected["max_by_cap"]:
                    failures.append(
                        f"{name}: max_by_cap {bounds.get('max_by_cap')} != {expected['max_by_cap']}"
                    )
                if bounds.get("max_by_cash") != expected["max_by_cash"]:
                    failures.append(
                        f"{name}: max_by_cash {bounds.get('max_by_cash')} != {expected['max_by_cash']}"
                    )
        else:
            if prop is not None:
                failures.append(f"{name}: expected no proposal for {expected['signal']}, got one")

        # Deterministic budget/usage accounting.
        usage = pack.usage
        if usage.total_tokens != usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens:
            failures.append(
                f"{name}: usage total {usage.total_tokens} != input {usage.input_tokens} + output {usage.output_tokens}"
            )
        if usage.stop_reason not in {"completed", "budget_exhausted", "error"}:
            failures.append(f"{name}: unknown usage stop_reason {usage.stop_reason!r}")

    # Network-blocked subprocess proves the replay path makes zero external calls.
    if pack_dirs:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            probe = _blocked_replay_probe(root, pack_dirs[0], Path(tmp))
            checks.append(f"blocked-network replay: signal={probe['signal']}, external_calls={probe['external_calls']}")
            if probe["external_calls"] != 0:
                failures.append("blocked-network replay reported nonzero external calls")
            expected0 = EXPECTED.get(pack_dirs[0].name, {})
            if expected0.get("signal") and probe["signal"] != expected0["signal"]:
                failures.append(
                    f"blocked-network replay signal {probe['signal']!r} != expected {expected0['signal']!r}"
                )

    # AT-07 semantic evaluation integration (source owner owns the module).
    try:
        module = __import__(EVAL_MODULE, fromlist=[EVAL_FUNC])
        evaluate = getattr(module, EVAL_FUNC)
        checks.append(f"integrated semantic evaluation: {EVAL_MODULE}.{EVAL_FUNC}")
        for pack_dir in pack_dirs:
            pack = io.import_pack(str(pack_dir))
            try:
                evaluate(pack)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                failures.append(f"semantic evaluation failed on {pack_dir.name}: {exc}")

        checks.append("SEMANTIC_EVAL_MISSING_INTEGRATION: True")
        checks.append(
            f"AT07_OFFLINE_SCOPE=deterministic facts/policy only; "
            f"integration required: provide {EVAL_MODULE}.{EVAL_FUNC}(pack) -> "
            "mandatory-fact accuracy, citation rate, support, relevance"
        )
        checks.append(
            "AT-07 live quality is NOT established by this gate; it requires the "
            "source owner's fixed six-case evaluation module and saved live evidence."
        )

    changed = changed_files(root, args.base_ref, args.head_ref, args.changed_files)
    if changed:
        prompt_changes = [
            c for c in changed
            if c.endswith(".py") or "prompt" in c.lower() or "/prompts/" in c
        ]
        if prompt_changes:
            checks.append(
                f"prompt/model change detected ({len(prompt_changes)} file(s)); "
                "fixed semantic gate applied to captured outputs (live quality requires "
                "fresh saved live evidence)"
            )

    fail(checks, failures)

from pathlib import Path

from _gate_lib import add_change_args, changed_files, fail, resolve_root

LOG_PATH = "docs/ai-use-log.yaml"
REQUIRED_ENTRY_FIELDS = ("date", "tool", "model", "purpose", "scope")


def is_code_or_prompt_change(path: str) -> bool:
    lower = path.lower()
    if path.endswith(".py"):
        return True
    if "prompt" in lower:
        return True
    if "/prompts/" in lower:
        return True
    return False


def covers(scope_item: str, file_path: str) -> bool:
    scope_item = scope_item.rstrip("/")
    if not scope_item:
        return False
    if file_path == scope_item:
        return True
    return file_path.startswith(scope_item + "/")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gate 6: AI-use log required for code/prompt changes.")
    add_change_args(parser)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root: Path = resolve_root(args.root)
    checks: list[str] = []
    failures: list[str] = []

    changed = changed_files(root, args.base_ref, args.head_ref, args.changed_files)
    code_prompt = sorted(c for c in changed if is_code_or_prompt_change(c))
    checks.append(f"changed files: {len(changed)}")
    checks.append(f"code/prompt changes requiring a log update: {len(code_prompt)}")

    if not code_prompt:
        checks.append("no code/prompt changes; AI-use log not required for this change set")
        fail(checks, failures)

    log_file = root / LOG_PATH
    if not log_file.exists():
        fail(checks, [f"code/prompt changed but {LOG_PATH} is missing"])

    try:
        data = yaml.safe_load(log_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except yaml.YAMLError as exc:
        fail(checks, [f"{LOG_PATH} is not valid YAML: {exc}"])

    checks.append(f"read {LOG_PATH}")

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        fail(checks, [f"{LOG_PATH} is not a YAML mapping"])

    for key in ("schema_version", "project", "decision_owner"):
        if not data.get(key):
            failures.append(f"{LOG_PATH} missing top-level key: {key}")

    entries = data.get("entries")
    if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
        failures.append(f"{LOG_PATH} must have a non-empty entries list")

    covered = set()
    valid_entries = 0
    for i, entry in enumerate(entries or []):
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            failures.append(f"entries[{i}] is not a mapping")
            continue
        valid_entries += 1
        for field in REQUIRED_ENTRY_FIELDS:
            if field not in entry or entry[field] in (None, ""):
                failures.append(f"entries[{i}] missing required field: {field}")
        scope = entry.get("scope")
        if scope is not None and not isinstance(scope, list):
            failures.append(f"entries[{i}] scope must be a list")
            scope = []
        for file_path in code_prompt:
            if any(covers(str(s), file_path) for s in (scope or [])):
                covered.add(file_path)

    checks.append(f"log entries: {len(entries or [])} (valid: {valid_entries})")

    uncovered = [f for f in code_prompt if f not in covered]
    if uncovered:
        failures.append("changed code/prompt files not covered by any log entry scope:")
        failures.extend(f"  {f}" for f in uncovered)
    else:
        checks.append("all changed code/prompt files are covered by a log entry scope")

    fail(checks, failures)

 # ADR-001: Extend the existing graph through application-owned seams
 
 Status: accepted by leo, 2026-08-31. Requirements: FR-001 through FR-003, INV-001, INV-002. The concrete plan and tests were approved at 12:05:17.791955 UTC before OpenCode's first implementation event at 12:06:32.695 UTC.
 
 ## Context and alternatives
 
 TradingAgents v0.4.0 already provides multi-agent research, structured decisions, date-aware memory, checkpointing and price validation. The missing product workflow is portable evidence followed by explicit approval and paper execution. A complete graph rewrite would discard tested domain behavior and make the optimization baseline incomparable. Editing every upstream prompt and tool would distribute application-specific policy across many owners. A narrow application extension keeps the experimental boundary visible.
 
 Candidate A modifies the entire graph and shared vendors. Candidate B subclasses/composes the existing graph and implements policy outside it. Candidate C builds a small new agent demo. The evaluation table selects B because it preserves genuine AI integration while keeping deterministic authority isolated. The original graph's full selected role sequence is retained in both experimental arms.
 
 ## Context layers and assembly
 
 Layer1 identifies the instrument and analysis cutoff. Layer2 states standing constraints: use available evidence, retain source identity, distinguish unknown facts and keep execution advisory. Layer3 supplies frozen market/history/news knowledge. Layer4 holds current discussion and retrieved past context. Layer5 preserves resumable structured state. Layer6 gives the current agent task and expected output.
 
 The assembly order is eligibility filtering, duplicate removal in compact mode, prioritization, budget accounting, compaction and final constraint reinjection. Baseline preserves original substantive prompt input. Compact can remove repeated paragraphs or shorten older discussion, while retaining symbol, date, price evidence, source IDs and current task. It also requests concise role output to reduce repeated prose passed to later agents. Fresh six-case runs have little past memory, so compact must apply to actual per-agent messages; changing only a memory string would leave the dominant token cost unchanged.
 
 The call budget is configured for the experiment. Per-call maximum output bounds use the provider's existing max_tokens contract. Character estimates may guide context assembly but never replace provider-reported token usage. The model adapter checks before starting a request; a structured-output retry cannot create an extra request after the budget is exhausted. Critical constraints are re-injected after compaction. Factual quality is evaluated independently of brevity.
 
 ## Consequences and reopening conditions
 
 Evidence packs contain prompts and responses and are larger than ordinary reports. Replay is fast because it reconstructs captured state; controlled reruns call the model and remain stochastic. The frozen provider must answer valid parameter variations from data, because an exact tool-transcript lookup would bias the comparison when compact changes tool arguments.
 
 The approval boundary stays outside all model tools. The extension retains responsibility for current-ledger checks even if upstream research changes. Reopen this ADR if an upstream public interface cannot expose a material external read, if multiuser concurrency is added, or if compact cannot satisfy factual constraints without discarding agent roles. No such need justifies silently replacing the baseline.
+
+## Affected paths
+
+The accepted application scope includes `src/research_desk/config.py`, `graph_adapter.py`, `budget.py`, `evidence.py`, `context.py`, `models.py`, `replay.py`, `report.py`, `cli.py` and the application-owned `src/research_desk/eval/` adapters. `pyproject.toml` exposes the installed extension. These paths implement the already approved evidence, research-context and runtime-budget boundaries. The deterministic approval and ledger changes are specified more precisely in ADR-002. No upstream vendor implementation is replaced.

+# Research Desk CI gates
+
+Decision owner: leo. The workflow is `.github/workflows/research-desk.yml`. OpenCode generated the check scripts; the coordinating workflow reviewed their behavior against the approved requirements and actual source interfaces. The six independent jobs are intended required checks for the private repository. Server-side branch protection is recorded separately after GitHub accepts or rejects the configuration request.
+
+| Gate | Blocking contract | Local command |
+|---|---|---|
+| 1. Tests approved before implementation | A scoped approval names the test/plan versions, covers AT-01 through AT-08, and predates implementation. Changed tests need a corresponding approval update. | `python scripts/check_approval.py` |
+| 2. Static and authority checks | Repository lint, application type checks and dependency consistency succeed. Deterministic policy owners cannot acquire LLM authority. Safety changes carry changed decision evidence. | `python scripts/check_static.py` |
+| 3. Requirements and traceability | The real YAML registry satisfies its JSON schema; requirement IDs and source/component/test mappings remain consistent. | `python scripts/check_requirements.py` |
+| 4. Fixed semantic regression | Replay fixed captured packs without networking and exercise the real compact transform on the six fixed source cases. Required facts and tool protocol remain intact. | `python scripts/check_semantic.py` |
+| 5. Regression | Both the preserved upstream `tests/` suite and application `test/offline/` suite succeed. Live API experiments are recorded separately. | `python scripts/check_regression.py` |
+| 6. AI-use log | A code or prompt change updates the log with a real session and a scope that covers the changed files. | `python scripts/check_ai_use_log.py` |
+
+The workflow uses Python 3.12. Mypy checks `src/research_desk` with imports outside that package skipped; the unchanged upstream project remains covered by its original tests and lint. No gate requires provider credentials. The semantic check measures deterministic input transformation and captured-output replay. The six-case live quality comparison uses separate actual provider calls and saved judgments; its results must not be inferred from an offline CI pass.
+
+The scripts accept a repository root and explicit changed-file input for controlled negative demonstrations. PR runs derive the change set from GitHub's base and head revisions. A failed Git query must fail change-dependent gates, and a new branch's all-zero `before` value is handled as the initial tree rather than accepted as a missing ref.
+
+## Supervision record
+
+The first CI session inspected the actual requirements, approval fields, fixture formats and application declarations. It then repeated baseline verification, so the coordinator interrupted it and sent a shorter implementation directive. The generated first draft had meaningful gaps: an invalid Git diff could appear as no changes, old approval evidence could cover arbitrary future tests, and semantic integration referred to a module that did not exist. These were returned to OpenCode as concrete corrections. The source owner separately received the actual application type findings and fixed them without suppressing the gate.
+
+Session: `ses_fa82cafc9ffeeAkOozPwPQ41De`. Raw events and prompts are retained under `transcripts/`; the initial inspection and intervention are part of the record. No source or test files were edited by the CI agent.

+## Execution evidence

+Implementation and integration review are in progress. The local six-gate execution, negative examples and final totals will replace this paragraph when those commands finish. This document does not claim a green run or installed branch protection before there is corresponding execution evidence.

+"""Live evaluation entry points: ``evaluate-case``, ``judge-case``, ``aggregate``.
+
+These are the real runnable application boundary for the frozen six-case
+comparison (AT-07 / FR-003 / QUALITY-001..003 / COST-001 / PERF-001):
+
+- ``run_evaluate_case`` runs ``ResearchRunner`` against the real
+  ``TradingAgentsGraph`` with real DeepSeek clients on the frozen CSV + case
+  notes for one case in one context mode (baseline/compact). It saves the exact
+  config, the full evidence pack (raw prompts/responses/tools/usage/events,
+  final state, reports), the measured wall time and the outcome.
+- ``run_judge_case`` uses the real DeepSeek client as an *isolated evaluator*
+  (separate role, fixed evidence and rubric, no baseline/compact identity) to
+  score a completed run's report, plus deterministic identity/date/price/state
+  and source-ID checks. Raw judge response and usage are recorded separately.
+- ``run_aggregate`` reads existing output directories and computes six paired
+  (baseline vs compact) metrics without calling any model again.
+
+Only host credentials are used: ``DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`` and optional
+``DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL``. Each run uses an isolated home directory. A completed or
+failed outcome means the actual graph outcome; a failed setup is never reported
+as completed.
+"""

+Evidence (frozen official source, source_id {case.get('source_id', 'n/a')}):
+{notes}

+Frozen latest close: {case['latest_close']:.2f}
+
+Deterministic checks already computed against the report:
+{facts}
+
+Judge the report below. Score support and relevance on 0-1 using the rubric:
+- support 1.0 = every key conclusion has direct support from the evidence; 0.8 = main conclusions supported with no key fabrication; 0.5 = important evidence gaps; 0 = key factual fabrication.
+- relevance 1.0 = fully focused on the requested ticker/date/task; 0.8 = core complete with minor redundancy; 0.5 = missing key parts; 0 = off task.
+Do NOT give 1.0 just because the report is nonempty. List which source IDs are valid citations (present and actually supporting the cited claim) and which factual claims are uncited.

+        "Read from existing run outputs; no model calls. Judge scores are attached when present.",

+        "|---|---|---|---|---|",

+        ("input_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
+        ("output_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
+        ("total_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
+        ("wall_seconds", "{:.1f}"),

 """Evidence capture, evidence packs, and offline replay primitives.
 
 Two capture channels feed an evidence pack:
 
 1. A LangChain callback handler (:class:`EvidenceRecorder`) attached to the
    graph's LLMs and tool calls. It records every LLM request/response with the
    provider-reported usage and every tool call/result.

    the ticker-identity lookup and the realized-returns read that happen inside
    ``TradingAgentsGraph`` itself. Those are recorded via
    :func:`record_data_read` from the adapter.

 manifest, the input snapshot, the event log, the final graph state, usage,

 def sanitize_secrets(obj: Any, _key: str = "") -> Any:
     """Recursively redact credential-looking keys so packs never hold secrets (SEC-001)."""
     if isinstance(obj, dict):
         out = {}
         for k, v in obj.items():
             kl = str(k).lower()
             if any(frag in kl for frag in _SECRET_KEY_FRAGMENTS):
                 out[k] = "**REDACTED**" if v not in (None, "") else v
             else:
                 out[k] = sanitize_secrets(v, kl)
         return out
     if isinstance(obj, list):
         return [sanitize_secrets(v, _key) for v in obj]
     if isinstance(obj, tuple):
         return [sanitize_secrets(v, _key) for v in obj]
     return obj

         # to propagate them. The budget guard lives in ``on_chat_model_start``

         self._start_llm(serialized, messages=messages, **kwargs)

         self._start_llm(serialized, prompts=prompts, **kwargs)

         # Enforce the budget BEFORE recording: a blocked call never starts.

         node = self._node_from_kwargs(kwargs)
         name = kwargs.get("name")
         model = (serialized or {}).get("id") or (serialized or {}).get("name")
         payload: dict[str, Any] = {"model": model or name or "unknown"}
         if messages is not None:
             payload["prompt"] = self._serialize_messages(messages)
         if prompts is not None:
             payload["prompt"] = "\n\n---PROMPT---\n\n".join(str(p) for p in prompts)
         self.log.record("llm_request", node=node, **payload)

+            parts: list[str] = []

                 else:
                     parts.append(_msg_to_text(group))
             return "\n\n".join(str(p) for p in parts if p)
         return str(messages)
 
     def on_llm_end(self, response: LLMResult, **kwargs) -> None:
         usage = _extract_usage(response)
         self.budget.record_usage(usage)
         node = self._node_from_kwargs(kwargs)
         text = None
         try:
             generation = response.generations[0][0]
             if hasattr(generation, "text"):
                 text = generation.text
         except (IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError):
             text = None
         self.log.record(
             "llm_response",
             node=node,
             input_tokens=usage.input_tokens,
             output_tokens=usage.output_tokens,
             response=text,
         )
 
     def on_llm_error(self, error, **kwargs) -> None:
         self.log.record("llm_response", node=self._node_from_kwargs(kwargs), error=str(error))
 
     def on_tool_start(self, serialized, input_str, **kwargs) -> None:
         name = kwargs.get("name") or (serialized or {}).get("name")
         node = self._node_from_kwargs(kwargs)
         try:
             args = json.loads(input_str) if input_str else {}
         except (TypeError, ValueError):
             args = {"raw": input_str}
         self.log.record("tool_call", node=node, name=name, args=args)
 
     def on_tool_end(self, output, **kwargs) -> None:
         self.log.record(
             "tool_result",
             node=self._node_from_kwargs(kwargs),
             name=kwargs.get("name"),
             result=_safe_str(output),
         )
 
     def on_tool_error(self, error, **kwargs) -> None:
         self.log.record(
             "tool_result",
             node=self._node_from_kwargs(kwargs),
             name=kwargs.get("name"),
             error=str(error),
         )
 
 
 def _msg_to_text(msg: Any) -> str:
     if hasattr(msg, "content"):
         return _safe_str(msg.content)
     return str(msg)
 
 
 def _safe_str(value: Any, limit: int = 200_000) -> str:
     s = value if isinstance(value, str) else str(value)
     return s[:limit]
 
 
 def _extract_usage(response: LLMResult) -> CallUsage:
     try:
         generation = response.generations[0][0]
     except (IndexError, TypeError):
         return CallUsage()
     if hasattr(generation, "message") and isinstance(generation.message, AIMessage):
         meta = getattr(generation.message, "usage_metadata", None) or {}
         return CallUsage(
             input_tokens=meta.get("input_tokens", 0) or 0,
             output_tokens=meta.get("output_tokens", 0) or 0,
         )
     return CallUsage()

 class EvidencePackError(Exception):
     """Raised when an evidence pack is missing required material or malformed."""
 
 
 def _data_snapshot_from_events(events: list[EvidenceEvent]) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
     """Rebuild the frozen tool-data snapshot from the tool_call/tool_result events.
 
     Keys are the canonical JSON of the tool arguments; values are the recorded
     result strings. This is the material a controlled rerun (``data_mode=frozen``)
     feeds back into the graph's tool nodes.
     """
     snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
     pending: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}  # seq -> (name, args_key)
     for ev in events:
         if ev.kind == "tool_call":
             name = ev.payload.get("name") or "unknown"
             args = ev.payload.get("args") or {}
             args_key = json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True, default=str)
             pending[ev.seq] = (name, args_key)
         elif ev.kind == "tool_result":
             name = ev.payload.get("name")
             result = ev.payload.get("result")
             if result is None:
                 continue
             source = pending.pop(ev.seq, None)
             if source is not None:
                 _, args_key = source
                 snapshot.setdefault(source[0], {})[args_key] = result
             elif name:
                 snapshot.setdefault(name, {})["__fallback__"] = result
     return snapshot

     def export(self, pack: EvidencePack, out_dir: str | Path) -> Path:

             json.dumps(sanitize_secrets(pack.final_state), indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
         )
         (out / "usage.json").write_text(
             json.dumps(pack.usage.model_dump(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
         )
         (out / "calls.json").write_text(
             json.dumps(sanitize_secrets([c.model_dump() for c in pack.calls]), indent=2),
             encoding="utf-8",

         if pack.proposal is not None:
             (out / "proposal.json").write_text(
                 json.dumps(pack.proposal.model_dump(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
             )
         meta = {"files": sorted(p.name for p in out.iterdir()), "complete": True}
         (out / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

         return out
 
     def export_zip(self, pack: EvidencePack, zip_path: str | Path) -> Path:
         zpath = Path(zip_path)
         zpath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
         with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
             for name, data in self._flatten(pack).items():
                 zf.writestr(name, data)
         return zpath
 
     @staticmethod
     def _flatten(pack: EvidencePack) -> dict[str, str]:
         files: dict[str, str] = {
             "manifest.json": json.dumps(sanitize_secrets(pack.manifest.model_dump()), indent=2),
             "input.json": json.dumps(sanitize_secrets(pack.input.model_dump()), indent=2),
             "events.jsonl": "\n".join(
                 json.dumps(sanitize_secrets(ev.model_dump())) for ev in pack.events
             ),
             "final_state.json": json.dumps(sanitize_secrets(pack.final_state), indent=2),
             "usage.json": json.dumps(pack.usage.model_dump(), indent=2),
             "calls.json": json.dumps(
                 sanitize_secrets([c.model_dump() for c in pack.calls]), indent=2
             ),
         }
         if pack.proposal is not None:
             files["proposal.json"] = json.dumps(pack.proposal.model_dump(), indent=2)

     def import_pack(self, source: str | Path) -> EvidencePack:
         """Load a complete evidence pack from a directory or ZIP.
 
         Raises :class:`EvidencePackError` with a clear message when required
         material is missing, so a partial pack can never silently replay.
         """
         src = Path(source)
         if src.is_dir():
             return self._load_dir(src)
         if zipfile.is_zipfile(src):
             import tempfile
 
             with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                 with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zf:
                     zf.extractall(tmp)
                 return self._load_dir(Path(tmp))
         raise EvidencePackError(f"Evidence source is neither a directory nor a ZIP: {src}")

     """TradingAgentsGraph subclass that records direct data paths and can freeze evidence."""
 
     def __init__(
         self,

                     {"mode": "frozen", "skipped": True, "trade_date": trade_date},

                     "raw_return": result[0],
                     "alpha_return": result[1],
                     "resolution_date": result[3],

         return result
 
 
 def price_from_evidence(snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]], ticker: str) -> float | None:
     """Extract the latest close for ``ticker`` from frozen get_stock_data evidence.
 
     This is the only price source for proposals — the operator never types a
     price. Returns ``None`` when no price evidence exists (the proposal then
     cannot be approved until evidence is supplied).
     """
     import csv
     import io
 
     table = snapshot.get("get_stock_data", {})
     best: float | None = None
     for result in table.values():
         if not result.startswith("# Stock data for"):
             continue
         # Skip the leading '#' comment lines so DictReader sees the real header.
         csv_lines = [ln for ln in result.splitlines() if ln and not ln.startswith("#")]
         if not csv_lines:
             continue
         try:
             rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO("\n".join(csv_lines))))
         except Exception:
             continue
         for row in reversed(rows):
             close = row.get("Close")
             if close:
                 try:
                     best = float(close)
                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
                     continue
                 break
     return best
 
 
 def merge_trace(trace: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
     final_state: dict[str, Any] = {}
     for chunk in trace:
         final_state.update(chunk)
     return final_state
 
 
 def decide_proposal(
     *,
     outcome: str,
     signal: str | None,
     run_id: str,
     ticker: str,
     trade_date: str,
     snapshot: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
     evidence_id: str | None = None,
 ) -> ProposalRecord | None:
     """Decide whether a run yields a PENDING_REVIEW proposal.
 
     The single place that enforces "a budget-stopped or failed run is never
     approvable, and Hold/REVIEW do not trade". Tradeable signals are the Buy
     family (buy) and Sell family (sell, validated against owned shares at
     execution); the price must come from evidence.
     """
     if outcome != RunOutcome.COMPLETED.value:
         return None  # budget-stopped / failed runs never become approvable (NFR-003)
     if not signal or is_review(signal):
         return None
     from .review import BUY_SIGNALS, SELL_SIGNALS, ReviewError
 
     if signal not in BUY_SIGNALS and signal not in SELL_SIGNALS:
         return None
     price = price_from_evidence(snapshot, ticker)
     if price is None:
         return None  # price must come from evidence; no price -> nothing to review
     try:
         return create_proposal(
             run_id=run_id,
             ticker=ticker,
             trade_date=trade_date,
             signal=signal,
             rating=signal,
             price=price,
             evidence_id=evidence_id,
         )
     except ReviewError:
         return None

     if signal in ("Hold", "REVIEW"):

 def approve(
     proposal: ProposalRecord,
     *,
     shares: int,

     """Approve an exact proposal version with an operator-supplied share count.
 
     The approval is bound to the proposal's *content* version, so if the run's
     material inputs (ticker/date/signal/price) later change, the old approval
     no longer matches and execution requires review.
     """
     if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED:
         raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is already simulated")
     if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED:
         raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is rejected and cannot be approved")
     # REVIEW_REQUIRED is a safe-fail state, not a dead end: after the operator
     # reviews the current evidence, they may approve the corrected version.
     if not operator:
         raise ReviewError("approval requires an operator identity")
     if not isinstance(shares, int) or shares <= 0:
         raise ReviewError(f"shares must be a positive integer, got {shares!r}")
     if proposal.price is None or proposal.price <= 0:
         raise ReviewError(
             f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} has no evidence price; cannot approve without price"
         )
     proposal.shares = shares
     proposal.operator = operator
     proposal.status = ProposalStatus.APPROVED
     proposal.approved_at = utcnow_iso()
     proposal.approved_version = _proposal_content_version(proposal)
     return proposal

         raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is already simulated")
     proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REJECTED
     proposal.operator = operator
     proposal.reason = reason
     return proposal

     # Sell-family signals now produce sell proposals (valid sells up to owned
     # shares execute); only Hold/REVIEW are non-tradeable.
     sell = decide_proposal(
         outcome=RunOutcome.COMPLETED.value, signal="Sell", run_id="r", ticker="AAPL",
         trade_date="2026-06-10", snapshot=snap,
     )
     assert sell is not None and sell.side == "sell"
     for bad_signal in ("Hold", "REVIEW"):

             outcome=RunOutcome.COMPLETED.value, signal=bad_signal, run_id="r",
             ticker="AAPL", trade_date="2026-06-10", snapshot=snap,

             outcome=bad_outcome, signal="Buy", run_id="r", ticker="AAPL",
             trade_date="2026-06-10", snapshot=snap,

         trade_date="2026-06-10", snapshot={},

Add conditional edges for current analyst\n            workflow.add_conditional_edges(\n                current_analyst,\n                getattr(self.conditional_logic, f\"should_continue_{spec.key}\"),\n                [current_tools, current_clear],\n            )\n            workflow.add_edge(current_tools, current_analyst)\n\n            # This module applies compaction to the\nactual message inputs each agent sends and to the output-length instruction,\nby wrapping the real LangChain chat model with a small application-owned\ndelegate that exposes the methods the graph actually uses — ``invoke``,\n``bind_tools`` and ``with_structured_output`` — while retaining the real\nLangChain client and upstream ``GraphSetup``.\n\nFor ``context_mode == \"baseline\"`` the delegate is a no-op: the exact, real\nuncompressed client is returned unchanged (no artificial padding, no rewrite).\nFor ``compact`` the delegate trims redundant message text, de-duplicates, and\nappends a concise-output instruction, while preserving key quoted facts (the\nstanding-constraints markers) in every affected prompt.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, BaseMessage, HumanMessage, SystemMessage\n\n# Content markers that carry the facts which must survive compaction. A message\n# containing any marker is kept (not trimmed below the fact floor).\n_FACT_MARKERS = (\n    \"STANDING ANALYSIS CONSTRAINTS\",\n    \"last_close\",\n    \"NO_DATA_AVAILABLE\",\n    \"source_id\",\n    \"src-\",\n    \"USD\",\n    \"% of equity\",\n    \"integer_shares\",\n    \"no_shorting\",\n    \"Analysis date\",\n    \"Company:\",\n    \"Instrument identity\",\n    \"trade_date\",\n    \"past_context\",\n)\n\n_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION = (\n    \"Respond concisely: keep your entire answer within {max_tokens} tokens. \"\n    \"Do not repeat the input; # TradingAgents Research Desk 项目方案\n2: \n3: 状态：leo已采纳，OpenCode正在实现。执行来源统一见 `../orchestration/README.md`。本文指标为验收目标，实测结果在后续报告中单列。\n4: \n5: ## 一、交付范围\n6: \n7: 在现有 TradingAgents 上交付完整流程：**运行研究 → 保存证据包 → 对照研究配置 → 审阅建议 → 确定性策略校验 → 更新模拟账本**。\n8: \n9: 第一版使用 CLI 和 HTML/Markdown 报告。只支持 market/news 分析员、US 股票和英语研究报告，仍沿用上游 bull/bear、research manager、trader、risk 与 portfolio manager 流程。完成可演示的纵向切片后再考虑界面美化，不接真实交易。\n10: \n11: 这三功能是可实现的起始范围。课程按 N 名组员提出新增需求，当前实际人数未知；后续按真实人数分配有意义的切片，不能把机械拆分当作个人贡献。\n12: \n13: ## 二、基线与只读核对结果\n14: \n15: 建议固定官方 [TradingAgents v0.4.0](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/tree/v0.4.0)，不用滚动 main。已通过 `git ls-remote --tags` 确认标签存在，并下载只读源码到 `/private/tmp/cs5351-tradingagents-v0.4.0`。包版本为0.4.0，要求Python>=3.10。\n16: \n17: v0.4.0于2026-08-31发布，包含日期一致性与恢复修复。它是正式标签，但刚发布，不能声称已长期稳定验证；开始实施时跑一次已有离线测试建立本地基线。[官方变更记录](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md)\n18: \n19: 已核对的实际接口：\n20: \n21: - `TradingAgentsGraph(selected_analysts, debug, config, callbacks)`。\n22: - `propagate(company_name, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\")` 返回 `(final_state, signal)`，signal可能为REVIEW。\n23: - `save_reports(final_state, ticker, save_path=None)` 输出报告。\n24: - 上游已有结构化输出、decision memory、checkpoint、日期过滤、价格验证、token统计。上述能力都属于继承功能，不能算作本组创新。\n25: - 实际图止于Portfolio Manager，随后保存状态和决策。对源码的查询未找到独立人工批准状态机或模拟账本；README的模拟执行概述不能代替实现证据。\n26: \n27: 保留上游 `tradingagents/`、`cli/` 和 `tests/`。新增模块放 `src/research_desk/`，新增课程测试放 `test/offline/`、`test/live/`，CI同时跑原测试。不要为符合目录树而重写上游代码。\n28: \n29: ## 三、新增需求\n30: \n31: ### F1：研究证据包与离线复现\n32: \n33: 保存分析日期、股票、模型/配置、prompt版本、实际输入资料、LLM请求/结果/usage、报告、决策及本次用到的记忆。导出资料包并生成来源索引。\n34: \n35: 离线复现读取已捕获状态与事件，重建报告和模拟策略结果，完全不调用网络。受控重跑则用冻结资料再次调用LLM，供比较配置；LLM的输出仍可能变化，两种功能需要明确区分。\n36: \n37: | ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n38: |---|---|---|\n39: | FR-001 | Must | 一条命令导出完整证据包，新进程可导入并重建报告；列出所有实际调用和运行配置 |\n40: | NFR-001 | Must | 固定6包离线复现成功率100%，外部调用数0，结构化决策/策略结果相同；本机单包重建<2秒 |\n41: | SEC-001 | Must | 输出不包含API凭证；所有未来才可用的资料不得用于声明为历史评估的研究 |\n42: \n43: 报告生成时间等展示元数据不参与一致性判断。文件摘要仅用于完整性，不充当用户版本号。上游已有价格snapshot；增量是跨输入、运行和结果的可移交证据包。\n44: \n45: ### F2：人工批准的模拟账本\n46: \n47: 研究结束产生待审阅建议。操作员选择股数并批准，系统根据当前账本、冻结价格与策略判断是否允许模拟执行。状态为 `PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED/REJECTED → SIMULATED/REVIEW_REQUIRED`。Hold或REVIEW不产生交易。\n48: \n49: 初版教学策略：现金USD100000、仅整股、禁止卖空、买入后单股票市值<=组合权益10%。批准绑定具体建议版本，执行前重查当前账本；重复执行同一批准不会重复记账。模型只建议方向和解释，不能设定政策、批准者或余额。\n50: \n51: | ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n52: |---|---|---|\n53: | FR-002 | Must | 用户可列出建议、看证据、批准/拒绝，观察账本和状态变化 |\n54: | NFR-002 | Must | 固定允许/拒绝/重复执行案例100%符合策略，策略裁决不调用LLM |\n55: | INV-001 | Must | 每项账本变化引用已批准建议版本及通过的确定性策略结果；违规次数0 |\n56: | INV-002 | Must | 未批准、上游REVIEW、资金/持仓不足、超限或价格缺失时不得改变账本；逃逸次数0 |\n57: \n58: 操作员直接调用review命令，记录实际本机操作者；研究LLM不能调用review或账本工具。第一版是单机个人工作台，不声称实现企业身份认证。安全失败返回明确的REVIEW_REQUIRED或业务拒绝，并保留账本原状态。\n59: \n60: ### F3：紧凑上下文与成本对照\n61: \n62: 增加研究调用预算、上下文装配和baseline/compact成对比较。保留股票身份、研究日期、关键价格、站立约束和当前任务；去重重复报告，压缩较旧讨论；压缩后重新加入关键约束。\n63: \n64: | ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n65: |---|---|---|\n66: | FR-003 | Must | 同一固定资料集输出两种配置的质量、调用数、input/output tokens、wall time和停止原因 |\n67: | NFR-003 | Must | 达到配置的调用数上限后不开始下一次LLM请求；预算停止结果不可进入可批准建议 |\n68: | QUALITY-001 | Must | 固定6组资料的强制事实字段正确率100%，引用有效率>=95%，支持度与相关性均>=0.8 |\n69: | COST-001 | Should | 同模型/资料/范围下compact总tokens降低>=20%，质量平均下降<=0.05 |\n70: | PERF-001 | Should | compact总wall time不高于baseline的110%，完整报告重试和所有样本 |\n71: \n72: 复用上游 `max_tokens` 作为每次输出上限，不另造同名配置。总token必须记录真实usage；不声称不同网关下有精确美元硬上限。2组资料用于开发，另4组在开发前冻结；最终完整跑两种配置各6组。引用、评分和应用token分开记录，避免评估费用被隐藏。\n73: \n74: MoSCoW取舍：先保证完整工作流和Must项，成本/性能提升有真实比较后才认定达成；图形界面、更多分析员、并行批处理和券商接入不进入第一版。\n75: \n76: ## 四、最小架构\n77: \n78: | 新模块 | 责任 | 复用点 |\n79: |---|---|---|\n80: | `research.py` | 研究生命周期和RunRecord | TradingAgentsGraph、配置、报告 |\n81: | `evidence.py` | 调用/输入记录、资料包、离线复现 | callbacks、现有报告写入器 |\n82: | `context.py` | 选择、去重、压缩、重注入关键约束 | 实际prompt所有者的局部接入 |\n83: | `budget.py` | 调用预算与实际usage | StatsCallbackHandler的计量方式、上游max_tokens |\n84: | `review.py` | 批准状态、策略、账本事务 | 最终signal仅作建议输入 |\n85: | `cli.py` 确定性策略校验 → 更新模拟账本**。\n\n第一版使用 CLI 和 HTML/Markdown 报告。只支持 market/news 分析员、US 股票和英语研究报告，仍沿用上游 bull/bear、research manager、trader、risk 与 portfolio manager 流程。完成可演示的纵向切片后再考虑界面美化，不接真实交易。\n\n这三功能是可实现的起始范围。课程按 N 名组员提出新增需求，当前实际人数未知；后续按真实人数分配有意义的切片，不能把机械拆分当作个人贡献。\n\n## 二、基线与只读核对结果\n\n建议固定官方 [TradingAgents v0.4.0](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/tree/v0.4.0)，不用滚动 main。已通过 `git ls-remote --tags` 确认标签存在，并下载只读源码到 `/private/tmp/cs5351-tradingagents-v0.4.0`。包版本为0.4.0，要求Python>=3.10。\n\nv0.4.0于2026-08-31发布，包含日期一致性与恢复修复。它是正式标签，但刚发布，不能声称已长期稳定验证；开始实施时跑一次已有离线测试建立本地基线。[官方变更记录](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md)\n\n已核对的实际接口：\n\n- `TradingAgentsGraph(selected_analysts, debug, config, callbacks)`。\n- `propagate(company_name, trade_date, asset_type=\"stock\")` 返回 `(final_state, signal)`，signal可能为REVIEW。\n- `save_reports(final_state, ticker, save_path=None)` 输出报告。\n- 上游已有结构化输出、decision memory、checkpoint、日期过滤、价格验证、token统计。上述能力都属于继承功能，不能算作本组创新。\n- 实际图止于Portfolio Manager，随后保存状态和决策。对源码的查询未找到独立人工批准状态机或模拟账本；README的模拟执行概述不能代替实现证据。\n\n保留上游 `tradingagents/`、`cli/` 和 `tests/`。新增模块放 `src/research_desk/`，新增课程测试放 `test/offline/`、`test/live/`，CI同时跑原测试。不要为符合目录树而重写上游代码。\n\n## 三、新增需求\n\n### F1：研究证据包与离线复现\n\n保存分析日期、股票、模型/配置、prompt版本、实际输入资料、LLM请求/结果/usage、报告、决策及本次用到的记忆。导出资料包并生成来源索引。\n\n离线复现读取已捕获状态与事件，重建报告和模拟策略结果，完全不调用网络。受控重跑则用冻结资料再次调用LLM，供比较配置；LLM的输出仍可能变化，两种功能需要明确区分。\n\n| ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n|---|---|---|\n| FR-001 | Must | 一条命令导出完整证据包，新进程可导入并重建报告；列出所有实际调用和运行配置 |\n| NFR-001 | Must | 固定6包离线复现成功率100%，外部调用数0，结构化决策/策略结果相同；本机单包重建<2秒 |\n| SEC-001 | Must | 输出不包含API凭证；所有未来才可用的资料不得用于声明为历史评估的研究 |\n\n报告生成时间等展示元数据不参与一致性判断。文件摘要仅用于完整性，不充当用户版本号。上游已有价格snapshot；增量是跨输入、运行和结果的可移交证据包。\n\n### F2：人工批准的模拟账本\n\n研究结束产生待审阅建议。操作员选择股数并批准，系统根据当前账本、冻结价格与策略判断是否允许模拟执行。状态为 `PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED/REJECTED → SIMULATED/REVIEW_REQUIRED`。Hold或REVIEW不产生交易。\n\n初版教学策略：现金USD100000、仅整股、禁止卖空、买入后单股票市值<=组合权益10%。批准绑定具体建议版本，执行前重查当前账本；重复执行同一批准不会重复记账。模型只建议方向和解释，不能设定政策、批准者或余额。\n\n| ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n|---|---|---|\n| FR-002 | Must | 用户可列出建议、看证据、批准/拒绝，观察账本和状态变化 |\n| NFR-002 | Must | 固定允许/拒绝/重复执行案例100%符合策略，策略裁决不调用LLM |\n| INV-001 | Must | 每项账本变化引用已批准建议版本及通过的确定性策略结果；违规次数0 |\n| INV-002 | Must | 未批准、上游REVIEW、资金/持仓不足、超限或价格缺失时不得改变账本；逃逸次数0 |\n\n操作员直接调用review命令，记录实际本机操作者；研究LLM不能调用review或账本工具。第一版是单机个人工作台，不声称实现企业身份认证。安全失败返回明确的REVIEW_REQUIRED或业务拒绝，并保留账本原状态。\n\n### F3：紧凑上下文与成本对照\n\n增加研究调用预算、上下文装配和baseline/compact成对比较。保留股票身份、研究日期、关键价格、站立约束和当前任务；去重重复报告，压缩较旧讨论；压缩后重新加入关键约束。\n\n| ID | 优先级 | 需求与fit criterion |\n|---|---|---|\n| FR-003 | Must | 同一固定资料集输出两种配置的质量、调用数、input/output tokens、wall time和停止原因 |\n| NFR-003 | Must | 达到配置的调用数上限后不开始下一次LLM请求；预算停止结果不可进入可批准建议 |\n| QUALITY-001 | Must | 固定6组资料的强制事实字段正确率100%，引用有效率>=95%，支持度与相关性均>=0.8 |\n| COST-001 | Should | 同模型/资料/范围下compact总tokens降低>=20%，质量平均下降<=0.05 |\n| PERF-001 | Should | compact总wall time不高于baseline的110%，完整报告重试和所有样本 |\n\n复用上游 `max_tokens` 作为每次输出上限，不另造同名配置。总token必须记录真实usage；不声称不同网关下有精确美元硬上限。2组资料用于开发，另4组在开发前冻结；最终完整跑两种配置各6组。引用、评分和应用token分开记录，避免评估费用被隐藏。\n\nMoSCoW取舍：先保证完整工作流和Must项，成本/性能提升有真实比较后才认定达成；图形界面、更多分析员、并行批处理和券商接入不进入第一版。\n\n##
